item.title: Ohio Sea Grant deploys robots for lake cleanup
item.description: Ohio Sea Grant recently completed another successful season deploying its trash-trapping robots – BeBot and PixieDrone – through partnerships with the Great Lakes Plastic Cleanup (GLPC) and funding and support provided by Midwest retailer Meijer. item.title: 80,000 rainbow trout to be stocked across Ohio
item.description: The Ohio DNR (ODNR) Division of Wildlife will release more than 80,000 rainbow trout at 93 locations beginning in March. The locations were chosen to give as many anglers as possible a chance to reel in these feisty fish in March, April, and May. Trout releases are designed for high angler success and harvest, according to the Division of Wildlife. The post 80,000 rainbow trout to be stocked across Ohio appeared first on Outdoor News.

item.title: Retired NFL player to host second ‘Buckeye Blast’ in Ohio to help young outdoors people
item.description: The Buckeye Blast is back after a successful inaugural year. The Light Foundation, co-founded by New England Patriots Hall of Famer and three-time Super Bowl champion Matt Light, will host its second annual fundraising event, The Buckeye Blast, on May 12, at Delaware, Ohio’s five-star Black Wing Shooting Center. item.title: So-called ‘trash birds’ show alarming decline in U.S.
item.description: Billions fewer birds are flying through North American skies than decades ago and their population is shrinking ever faster, mostly due to a combination of intensive agriculture and warming temperatures, a new study found. item.title: Leaders urge Congress to focus on Ohio River
item.description: Legislation pending in Congress could bring new resources and strategies for job creation, recreation, commerce, and public drinking water across the Ohio River Basin. The potential impact is highlighted by Craig Butler, executive director of the Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District (MWCD), and also Dr. Chris Lorentz, of Thomas More University and chair of the Ohio River Basin Alliance (ORBA). item.title: 36 million fish stocked in Ohio waters in 2025
item.description: More than 36 million fish were stocked by the Ohio DNR (ODNR) Division of Wildlife in Ohio’s public lakes, ponds, rivers, and streams in 2025.
